title: The Convention
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael prepares for the Annual Northeastern Mid-Market Office Supply Convention in Philadelphia, revealing his desire to adopt a baby inspired by Angelina Jolie. Tensions arise as Michael and Jan set ground rules about Carol during the convention, while Angela expresses disappointment over Dwight's trip. Michael hosts a party at the convention, inviting notable guests and investigating a rival, Josh. Meanwhile, Pam navigates nervousness about a first date after nine years and reflects on her feelings about future relationships. Jim clarifies his transfer motivations related to Pam, and Jan and Josh discuss scheduling amidst the convention events.

main_threads.thread: Michael's preparation and activities at the office supply convention, including his party planning, business deals, and interpersonal conflicts.
